objective: A proof at every level, through the two-to-one map between levels, that the seven patterns live exactly at the levels of one parity (from some level on), or a level where the alternation stops.
status: Proved 2026-11-14: #2 parity alive at every odd level, #3 first-XOR-last at every even level (finite product check); rigidity of #2 reduced pattern implies its even deaths (certified rigid 6-14; all levels open). Referee pending.
title: Why the seven parity-alternating patterns alternate
